prompt:
Create formal meeting minutes focused on decisions made. Here's the discussion:

We spent about 40 minutes debating whether to use PostgreSQL or MongoDB for the new analytics service. Elena argued for Postgres because we already have expertise and it handles complex queries well. Raj pushed for Mongo because the data is semi-structured and schema changes frequently. After looking at the pros and cons, we voted. Postgres won 3-1. We also discussed hosting - AWS RDS vs self-hosted. Decided to go with RDS for now, managed service saves ops time, we can revisit if costs become an issue. Last item was timeline. Q3 or Q4? Elena wants Q3, Raj says Q4 is more realistic given current commitments. Compromise: start in Q3 with minimal scope, expand in Q4.
expected: decisions with rationale: (1) PostgreSQL chosen over MongoDB (3-1 vote, expertise + complex queries), (2) AWS RDS over self-hosted (ops savings, revisit if costly), (3) Q3 start minimal scope, Q4 expand (compromise). Clear decision/alternatives/rationale structure.

prompt:
Give me a 2-3 sentence executive summary of this 1-hour project review:

We went through all 5 workstreams. Workstream 1 (User Research) - completed 12 interviews, synthesized findings, 3 major pain points identified. On track. Workstream 2 (Visual Design) - high-fidelity mockups done for desktop, tablet version started, slightly behind (1 week). Workstream 3 (Frontend) - component library 60% built, waiting on design signoff for 3 components. Workstream 4 (Backend) - all APIs done except payment integration which is blocked on legal review. Workstream 5 (QA) - test plan written, automated testing framework set up, ready to start when frontend delivers. Overall assessment: green on 3 streams, yellow on 2 (Design and Backend/payments). Budget at 85% consumed, timeline at 70%, we're trending slightly over budget but within acceptable range. Key risk is the legal review for payments - could take 2-8 weeks, unknown. Team morale is good, no burnout flags. Next review in 2 weeks.
expected: 2-3 sentence executive summary capturing: project overall on track (3 green 2 yellow), main risk is payment integration blocked on legal review, budget at 85% trending slightly over. Concise, no details.

prompt:
Structure this brainstorm into organized themes with next steps:

OK team let's brainstorm how to improve user retention. Going around the room:
- Push notifications for inactive users
- Better onboarding tutorial
- Gamification - badges, streaks, points
- Email digest with personalized recommendations
- Social features - share achievements with friends
- AI-powered content recommendations
- Simplify the signup flow, it's like 5 screens right now
- Add a dark mode, people keep asking
- Referral program - give existing users credits for inviting
- Better search with filters
- In-app guided tours for new features
- Community forum or Discord
- Weekly challenges or competitions
- Progress tracking dashboard
- Integration with calendar apps for reminders

Everyone voted on top 3 ideas. Results: (1) Better onboarding - 8 votes, (2) Push notifications - 7 votes, (3) Referral program - 6 votes.
expected: themes: engagement features (notifications, gamification, email digest, challenges), UX improvements (onboarding, signup flow, dark mode, guided tours), social/community (share, forum, referral), discovery (AI recommendations, search). Top 3 by votes highlighted. Next steps implied.
